one_line: Agent-native infinite whiteboard for structured spatial co-creation.
what_it_does: Provides an infinite canvas where human drawings and agent operations share structured diagram state, including layout, connectors, themes, and introspection.
leverage_rationale: Structured canvas state and atomic spatial operations materially improve agent precision over UI driving, though a capable vision/UI agent could approximate parts of the workflow.
leverage_evidence: About claims get_canvas_state, connect_elements, apply_theme, create_diagram, and 11 registered browser tools.
Frame sheet visibly shows repeated dark canvas/panel states plus developer/console evidence, but labels are not legible.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent, ambitious canvas workflow and live demo, with visible product and technical surfaces; end-to-end details are not fully legible.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive and public repository with tests claimed.
Frame sheet shows multiple product states and implementation/debug views.
impact_rationale: Architecture and data-flow design is a real recurring use case for engineers and technical teams, with credible value from shared spatial state.
impact_evidence: Pitch targets architecture, data-pipeline, and brainstorming workflows.
Claims collision-free layout, routing, and agent-human co-creation.
creativity_rationale: Treating a whiteboard as a structured spatial playground for agents is a fresh interaction model pursued across layout, routing, styling, and introspection.
creativity_evidence: Agent-native infinite whiteboard framing.
Bi-directional co-creation and spatial introspection are central rather than decorative.
usability_note: Promising canvas workflow; evidence is visually dense and small.
red_flags: No submitted video; frame sheet text is too small to verify exact tool calls.
advance_reason: Strong concept and meaningful structured-state delta, with enough coherent evidence to advance despite limited legibility.

one_line: Agent-native scored city guide for jointly planning nights out.
what_it_does: Lets people and agents search scored venues, inspect details and hours, draft itineraries, and return booking links from the same page.
leverage_rationale: Embedded tools expose live catalog, scoring, hours, and booking data reliably, reducing scraping and hallucination; the outcome remains possible with general browsing at real friction.
leverage_evidence: Claims five tools over a production venue API.
Shared page preserves the site's source of truth and returns structured venue data.
execution_rationale: The described flow is coherent and appropriately scoped, with a live demo and concrete catalog coverage, though no readable visual evidence was available.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive.
Claims coverage of 19,000+ venues across 24 cities and a complete search-to-itinerary flow.
impact_rationale: Planning a night out is a clear, common audience need, and combining venue judgment with agent legwork offers credible practical value.
impact_evidence: Explicit dinner/cocktails itinerary use case.
Structured hours, locations, scored venues, and booking links address concrete planning friction.
creativity_rationale: A thoughtful agent-native extension of a known city-guide category, with the shared-page/source-of-truth framing as the main new angle.
creativity_evidence: One-page human-agent co-planning model.
Scored-not-starred positioning and read-only planning tools.
usability_note: Clear user-facing use case and low-friction read-only collaboration.
red_flags: No video and no gallery images; packet relies on description.
standouts: Live-data grounding is directly relevant to agent reliability.
advance_reason: Credible real-world value and a meaningful WebMCP improvement warrant advancement.

one_line: A browser-local agent rewrites a guarded website to fit visitor context.
what_it_does: Publishes constrained page fields to an agent, accepts one structured rewrite call, stages personalized copy, and supports one-click restoration.
leverage_rationale: The page-local writing contract, field budgets, and shared state make safe targeted personalization substantially more reliable than generic UI automation or server-side profiling.
leverage_evidence: Claims 29 guarded fields and one write_all call with deterministic staging.
Context and rewritten text remain in-browser; page defines the contract.
execution_rationale: The concept is unusually specific and internally coherent, with explicit guardrails and restore behavior; end-to-end execution is claimed rather than fully observable.
execution_evidence: Claims sub-second deterministic headline reminting, skeleton reveal, and restoration.
Two gallery images and live demo are listed.
impact_rationale: Marketing and e-commerce teams have a real personalization problem, and visitor-controlled context could provide useful relevance without tracking.
impact_evidence: Concrete industrial-pump and outdoor-apparel examples.
Claims privacy-preserving browser-local personalization and prefilled conversion form.
creativity_rationale: The agent writes the page itself under a page-owned contract, reversing the usual agent-operates-site pattern; this is a novel and memorable interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Explicit inversion: agent does not operate the site, it writes it.
Guarded field-level rewrite with human restore is deeply pursued.
usability_note: Clear before/after and restore affordances are strong usability choices.
red_flags: No submitted video; visual end-to-end proof is limited.
advance_reason: Exceptional creativity plus a substantial, safety-oriented WebMCP delta make this a clear advance.

one_line: Agent-ready workspace for operating complex research protocols.
what_it_does: Coordinates studies, subjects, visits, assessments, samples, tasks, checklists, synchronization, and advancement criteria in one workflow workspace.
leverage_rationale: Operational research state is difficult to infer safely from pixels; structured imperative tools can coordinate records and enforce advancement logic with materially higher reliability.
leverage_evidence: Claims fourteen imperative WebMCP tools covering portfolio and study operations.
Explicit readiness checks and synchronized records address structured-state needs.
execution_rationale: The scope and workflow are coherent, but the packet has no repository, no gallery, and no transcript; claimed functionality is not sufficiently demonstrated end-to-end.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive.
Description enumerates priorities, protocol publishing, checklists, task completion, and blocked advancement reasons.
impact_rationale: Research coordinators have a concrete, high-friction operational problem where missed tasks and inconsistent records matter; the proposed workflow directly addresses it.
impact_evidence: Specific coordinator workflows and synthetic multi-study records.
Explicit no-PHI claim and readiness/blocked-reason handling.
creativity_rationale: A protocol-as-operational-workflow framing with agent coordination is a fresh synthesis, though it extends established research-management concepts.
creativity_evidence: Turns static protocols into shared agent-ready workflows.
Visual protocol-to-visit-checklist pipeline.
usability_note: Workflow-oriented information architecture appears promising, but evidence is thin.
red_flags: No public repo, gallery, or transcript; execution claims are weakly evidenced.
standouts: Strong domain fit for structured tools.
Explicit safety boundary around fictional records/no PHI.
advance_reason: High impact and leverage potential justify advancement, with execution uncertainty flagged.

one_line: Map-first copilot for exploring urban housing scenarios and trade-offs.
what_it_does: Evaluates candidate sites against planning constraints, supports scenario branches and shortlists, and prepares decisions for planner approval.
leverage_rationale: Shared map state and structured scenario actions are materially more precise than asking a general agent to manipulate a map UI, especially for repeatable analysis and shortlist changes.
leverage_evidence: Claims tools for analysis, constraints, map movement, shortlist, scenarios, and approval preparation.
Concrete result: about 1,098-home capacity versus 2,000-home goal.
execution_rationale: The demo is marked dead and no frame sheets were submitted, so the central workflow cannot be verified despite a coherent description.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=dead.
No video frame sheets; only packaging screenshot is listed.
impact_rationale: Housing planning is a consequential, clearly defined use case, and trade-off exploration could provide credible value to planners even at city scale.
impact_evidence: Mission/SoMa housing target and shortfall are concrete.
Factors include transit, flood risk, parks, schools, zoning, and capacity.
creativity_rationale: The shared map plus scenario-branching planner-agent collaboration is a fresh synthesis with meaningful ambition.
creativity_evidence: AI explores consequences while planner retains approval control.
Scenario comparison and shortlist operations are integrated.
usability_note: Potentially useful map workflow, but unavailable demo prevents usability assessment.
red_flags: Dead demo and no submitted video/frame evidence.
advance_reason: The dead demo and absent product evidence prevent confidence in execution at this stage.

one_line: Human-approved agent assistance for tailoring resumes to jobs.
what_it_does: Analyzes job and resume materials, identifies gaps, scores ATS coverage, proposes bullet and cover-letter changes as diffs, and exports only accepted edits.
leverage_rationale: Shared page state and explicit diff/approval workflow improve safe precision over generic automation, but general agents can achieve much of the same outcome with friction.
leverage_evidence: Three model-backed tools plus declarative intake tools are claimed.
Agent proposes; human accepts or rejects; export is acceptance-gated.
execution_rationale: The product scope is coherent, intentional, and centered on a complete intake-analysis-diff-export flow; live demo and repository support the claim.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive and public repo.
Description specifies PDF/Word intake, job paste, analysis, diffs, review, and export.
impact_rationale: Job seekers have a clear, widespread need for tailored applications without uncontrolled rewriting; the human approval model directly addresses trust.
impact_evidence: Concrete resume/job-posting workflow.
Before/after bullet diffs and human-only acceptance are explicit.
creativity_rationale: A known career tool category gains a strong trust-centered interaction model where the agent proposes and the applicant decides.
creativity_evidence: Diff-first editing and acceptance-gated export.
WebMCP declarative forms avoid silent submission.
usability_note: Clear review and reject controls fit the sensitive-document use case.
red_flags: No submitted video despite a claimed recorded demo; frame evidence is the main visual support.
standouts: Useful provenance/trust boundary for personal documents.
advance_reason: Clear audience value, coherent execution claims, and a meaningful approval-oriented agent workflow.

one_line: Browser-local deterministic masking and restoration for sensitive contract data.
what_it_does: Detects and masks personal data with regexes and checksums, lets an agent use the sanitized text, then restores original values locally.
leverage_rationale: Page-local structured masking is central to the privacy promise; generic UI automation cannot safely substitute for deterministic, inspectable in-page transformation and controlled agent access.
leverage_evidence: Claims no document text leaves the browser and no LLM is used for detection.
Tool masks in-page without arguments and rehydrates values after processing.
execution_rationale: The deterministic detection scope, restoration flow, and protocol constraints are coherent and technically intentional; full end-to-end evidence is limited.
execution_evidence: Claims IBAN, Luhn, DNI/NIE, CIF, and Italian VAT validation.
Two gallery images and live demo are listed.
impact_rationale: Law, accounting, and other regulated users have a real privacy barrier to cloud AI; local masking directly enables safer document assistance.
impact_evidence: Concrete EU law/accounting audience and GDPR/AI Act concern.
Coverage includes names, identifiers, financial data, and addresses.
creativity_rationale: The combination of deterministic multi-country identity detection, browser-local privacy, and agent-mediated round-trip restoration is a strong original application of WebMCP.
creativity_evidence: Agent never receives the original document directly.
Real checksums replace probabilistic LLM detection.
usability_note: Privacy-preserving flow is compelling; coverage and false-positive handling need observation.
red_flags: No submitted video; claims of detection coverage are not fully testable from packet.
advance_reason: WebMCP is tightly coupled to the safety model and the audience problem is real and consequential.

leverage_rationale: Shared authenticated state, server-mirrored tool schemas, provenance gates, and async work items make agent operation markedly more reliable than scraping a career dashboard.

execution_evidence: Live demo, public repo, 151-second video.

impact_evidence: Personal motivation and concrete pipeline/search/document workflows.
Readiness-aware prioritization and provenance-linked claims address practical trust and timing needs.
creativity_rationale: Persistent career memory combined with an authenticated, provenance-gated, async agent surface is an ambitious and memorable synthesis.

one_line: Agent purchasing protocol for licensed publisher content with human-controlled payment.
what_it_does: Lets an agent inspect a priced source, obtain human approval, purchase through a local wallet under policy, and unlock canonical cited content.
leverage_rationale: Structured offers, rights, entitlements, idempotent purchase, and human approval create a machine-readable commercial flow that generic page automation cannot safely reproduce.
leverage_evidence: Explicit inspect_source, unlock_source, and local purchase_offer sequence.
Wallet validates offer, amount, currency, rights, policy, and idempotency.
execution_rationale: The protocol is sharply scoped and technically coherent, with a concrete flow and public repo; no video or gallery limits observed confidence.
execution_evidence: Public repo and live demo claimed.
Detailed code-like purchase flow and entitlement semantics in packet.
impact_rationale: Publishers need compensation and agents need authoritative sources; a human-approved micropayment/content entitlement flow addresses both sides credibly, even as a prototype.
impact_evidence: Specific publisher revenue problem and agent access gap.
Canonical citation and source-scoped entitlement support trustworthy answers.
creativity_rationale: Agent-mediated paid access with explicit rights, local wallet policy, and human approval is a genuinely novel interaction and ambitious economic protocol.
creativity_evidence: Payment authority is deliberately separated from publisher page.
Exact price/rights approval precedes idempotent redemption.
usability_note: Conceptual flow is clear; test-credit prototype and absent visual evidence leave practical UX uncertain.

Operational publisher adoption is not demonstrated, though not required for impact.
standouts: Exceptional protocol clarity and WebMCP necessity.
advance_reason: Highly differentiated, transformative agent-commerce concept with a credible protocol despite limited execution evidence.

one_line: Turn-based learning game where a voice agent grows a knowledge tree without cheating.
what_it_does: A human and voice agent alternate constrained moves on a shared knowledge canvas, building concepts, resources, skills, and gaps toward a win condition.
leverage_rationale: Tool-only agent moves and enforced turn/rule state make the agent a governed game participant; generic UI driving could not as reliably preserve the anti-cheating contract.
leverage_evidence: Agent can only change the board through registered tools.
Explicit alternating turns, ten-move limit, node/gap win condition, and human-only undo.
execution_rationale: The game rules and interaction loop are clearly specified and the packet lists live demo/repo evidence, though end-to-end execution is not fully inspectable.
execution_evidence: demo_alive=alive and public repo.
Concrete node types, moves, turn order, and win condition are described.
impact_rationale: Learners seeking active study and conversational AI practice have a clear audience; game constraints can encourage structured recall and identifying gaps.
impact_evidence: Learning-game framing around a single question.
Gap marking/clearing and resource/skill nodes connect play to study behavior.
creativity_rationale: A voice-controlled, rule-bound alternating knowledge-tree game is a distinctive interaction model that uses WebMCP as the anti-cheating mechanism.
creativity_evidence: Agent is a constrained player rather than a chat overlay.
Shared canvas, turn rules, and human-only undo create memorable game dynamics.
usability_note: Rules are legible and motivating; voice-agent reliability would need observation.
red_flags: No submitted video; packet mentions prior experiments/domain history, so origin is judged new for this implementation.
standouts: WebMCP changes the game rules, not merely convenience.
advance_reason: Distinctive concept with genuine tool-enforced interaction and credible learning value.
